description:
Register an agent's birth. Issues a content-addressed genesis
    certificate with a strictly monotone index (epoch 0 = the founding
    cohort). parent_id records lineage; children of recalled/quarantined
    parents are quarantined at birth. Idempotent — an agent is born once.

artifact_hash.description: Optional. SHA-256 of the agent's code or model.
artifact_hash.title: Artifact Hash

parent_id.description: Optional. Id of the parent agent, to record lineage.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

name: register_genesis
title: Register genesis
